chunks: Saad ibn Abdullah from al-Husayn ibn Ali al-Zaytuni from Ahmad ibn Hilal from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abi Basir from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

"Whoever wishes to be greeted by one hundred thousand prophets and twenty thousand prophets, let him visit the grave of al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him) in the middle of Sha'ban, for indeed the souls of the prophets (peace be upon them) ask permission of Allah to visit him, and permission is granted to them."

key_terms.يُصَافِحَهُ: to greet or shake hands with

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of visiting Imam Husayn's grave in the middle of Sha'ban?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq) establishes the mid-Sha'ban visitation as a unique occasion where the spirits of 144,000 prophets seek divine permission to greet the visitor, emphasizing Imam al-Husayn’s elevated spiritual status. This tradition underscores the concept of *Ruhaniyyat* (spiritual presence) in Shia piety, linking the Ahl al-Bayt intimately with the prophetic lineage. The promise of such a vast assembly highlights the intercessory and honorific role of Imam al-Husayn within the cosmic hierarchy of the faithful.
